desc: Derive the structural characterization of shortest paths in the disjoint-interval graph.
Reduce minimum-weight path queries to direct, common-neighbor, and proper-crossing cases.
Design \(O(N+Q)\) preprocessing and query handling using prefix/suffix minimum weights.
Handle endpoint weights, coordinate bounds, disconnected vertices, and 64-bit sums.
Validate the implementation against both public samples and relevant interval edge cases.
